observation: Primary mobile navigation obscures focus and presents excessive first-level choices.
why_penalized: Higher decision load and loss of keyboard orientation.
root_cause: Navigation information architecture and overlay focus management are coupled incorrectly.
user_impact: Slower discovery and keyboard trap risk.
recommended_action: Reduce top-level choices and implement deterministic focus management/current-page state.
validation: Keyboard regression test at mobile viewport plus repeated navigation task.
